scripts.build: bun run generate:release-highlights && bun run build:wxt:firefox
scripts.build:all: bun run build:chrome && bun run build
scripts.build:chrome: bun run generate:release-highlights && bun run build:wxt
scripts.start:androidwin11: adb connect 127.0.0.1:58526 && web-ext run -s src -t firefox-android --adb-device 127.0.0.1:58526 --firefox-apk org.mozilla.fenix
scripts.start:chromedevwin: web-ext run -s src -t chromium --chromium-binary 'C:\Program Files\Google\Chrome Dev\Application\chrome.exe' -u 'https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Special:Random' --bc
scripts.test:all: bun run test && bun run test:e2e
scripts.test:e2e: bun run build:wxt && playwright test --config playwright.config.js src/tests/e2e/wxt-smoke.spec.js
scripts.test:e2e:legacy: bun run build:wxt && playwright test --config playwright.config.js src/tests/e2e/extension.spec.js src/tests/e2e/notifications.spec.js src/tests/e2e/batch-processing.spec.js src/tests/e2e/command-download-regression.spec.js src/tests/e2e/live-public.spec.js
